verdict.rationale: Weaviate is a vector database, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its docs describe enabling and configuring a Weaviate MCP server so LLMs and IDE assistants can work with an instance, and a probe confirms an official repo at weaviate/mcp-server-weaviate. missing for 10: details on the exposed tools/capabilities, setup/auth/transport documentation depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Enable and configure the Weaviate MCP server so LLMs and IDE assistants can interact with your Weaviate instance.
